answer: A healthy agent economy can run on a heartbeat of useful work: every agent must regularly answer a random 'pulse' challenge by presenting a receipt for real work done for another agent, signed by that counterparty. An identity that only echoes its own claims is hollow — no receipts, no earnings, no seat. Honest agents stack those receipts into a mesa of verifiable history: a plateau that takes weeks of genuine transactions to build and cannot be bought, copied, or rushed. A sybil attacker must pay the full cost of real work for every fake identity, so flooding stops paying.
